c74object.name: mc.syncSuite.limiter~
c74object.digest: True-peak lookahead limiter for speaker layouts.
c74object.description: Brickwall lookahead limiter. The required gain min(1, ceiling / true peak) is followed by a sliding minimum over the lookahead, an exponential release and a moving average over the lookahead: every sample, and the samples around it that its inter-sample peak is built from, get at most the gain they need, so the gain reaches its target exactly when the peak arrives, without overshoot and without distortion from a hard attack. True peak: 4x polyphase interpolation (48 taps per branch) with a parabolic refinement between the oversampled points, aligned with the sample it describes. Measured against an independent 16x reference on hot noise band-limited to 20 kHz: at most 0.02 dB over the ceiling; content at the Nyquist frequency itself (full-band white noise) can exceed it by up to ~0.5 dB, where a true peak is ambiguous. FOLD-DOWN GUARD (fold stereo / mono): the stereo fold of the layout (as mc.syncSuite.virtualspeakers~ stereo mode) or its mono sum is kept under fold_ceiling too; every channel feeding the fold takes its reduction. SAFETY CLIP: anything that still exceeds the ceiling at a sample is clipped and counted (clips): a violation can never go unnoticed. Latency: lookahead + 25 samples (0.5 ms at 48 kHz) + 1 sample. CPU: about 0.18% of a core per channel at 48 kHz (Apple Silicon), true peak on, with metering. Built for speaker layouts. LINK GROUPS: every channel belongs to a group (groups attribute; default: all mains in one group, the LFE channels in another). Within a group, link 0..1 blends each channel's own control signal with the group's; at 1 every speaker of the group gets the same gain at every sample, so relative levels, and with them the spatial image, cannot move. EXACT REPORTING: the gain reduction shown and output is the gain actually multiplied into the audio (after linking, ballistics, lookahead and mix), excluding make-up / drive. IMAGE: the input and output energy vectors (Gerzon, from speaker_coords) are compared over 400 ms: the display and the image message give how many degrees the processing turned the image and how much it widened (negative) or narrowed it. DISPLAY: meters (input dim, output bright, gain reduction from the top, hold, link-group colour under each channel), history (the last 10 s of gain reduction per channel, deepest reduction on top), curve (static curve and every channel's operating point), image, statistics (max reduction, share of time reducing, latency). BYPASS keeps the latency and the meters (they show what would be done). Latency is output as latency <samples> <ms> whenever it changes. Nothing is emulated: feed-forward, log-domain gain computer, no saturation.

method.name: signal
method.digest: Speaker feeds, channel i = speaker i

method.name: get
method.description: gr, gr_max, in_peak_max, out_peak_max (per channel, dB), image (shift deg, width change, azimuth in, azimuth out), stats (max reduction dB, % of time reducing, seconds, clips), latency (samples, ms).

attribute.name: speaker_coords
attribute.description: One per channel, deg, 0 = front, clockwise (as syncSuite.nodes). Empty = even ring of the non-LFE channels. Used for the image and the fold-down.

attribute.name: speaker_elevations
attribute.description: Degrees, up, one per channel (missing = 0). All spatial computations are in 3D; the displays are top views.

attribute.name: lfe
attribute.description: Not positioned; own group by default.

attribute.name: groups
attribute.digest: Link group per channel (empty = mains / LFE)
attribute.description: Any integers, one per channel (a shorter list repeats its last value). Empty = mains / LFE.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Link group per channel (empty = mains / LFE)

attribute.name: link
attribute.digest: Link within groups (0 = independent, 1 = same gain)
attribute.description: 0 = independent channels, 1 = the same gain for the whole group (default).

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: Link within groups (0 = independent, 1 = same gain)

attribute.name: bypass
attribute.description: Output = input (latency-aligned; multiband: the band sum); meters keep showing what would be done. Default: 0.

attribute.name: ceiling
attribute.description: Default -1. dBFS when truepeak is off.

attribute.name: drive
attribute.description: Applied before the limiter, smoothed. Not part of the gain reduction. Default: 0.

attribute.name: release
attribute.description: Exponential, upwards only. Default 80.

attribute.name: lookahead
attribute.description: 0.02 to 20 ms, default 3. Changing it while playing clicks (the delay changes).

attribute.name: truepeak
attribute.description: On (default) or sample peak. Default: 1.

attribute.name: fold
attribute.description: Values: 0 = off, 1 = stereo, 2 = mono (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: fold_ceiling
attribute.description: Default -1.

attribute.name: safety_clip
attribute.description: On (default): samples still over the ceiling are clipped and counted. Default: 1.

attribute.name: view
attribute.description: Which panels are drawn: all, or one of them filling the box. Values: 0 = all, 1 = meters, 2 = history, 3 = curve, 4 = image (a number or the name). Default: 0.

attribute.name: meter_min
attribute.description: Default: -60.

attribute.name: select
attribute.description: Also by clicking a meter. Default: 0.

attribute.name: select_band
attribute.description: Default: 1.

attribute.name: bypass_ui
attribute.description: 1: nothing is drawn and the display timer stops; the audio and the message output are not affected (use it when the box is hidden or while performing). Default: 0.

attribute.name: no_ui
attribute.digest: No UI: a plain object box (set it when typing the object: @no_ui 1)
attribute.description: Type it with the object (mc.syncSuite.limiter~ @no_ui 1): the box looks and sizes like a standard object box, draws nothing, runs no display timer and skips the display-only metering. Max decides per class whether a box is a UI box, so the box stays resizable, but it behaves as a standard object: audio, messages and get work as usual. Default: 0.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: No UI: a plain object box (set it when typing the object: @no_ui 1)

attribute.name: output
attribute.description: 1: the measurements (see get) are output at every display refresh with new data. 0: only on get.

attribute.name: interval
attribute.description: Display refresh and output rate. The processing does not depend on it. Default: 33.

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: Box background (syncSuite style: near black).

attribute.name: panelcolor
attribute.description: Panel background.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: Labels and numbers.

attribute.name: gridcolor
attribute.description: Scales and guides.

attribute.name: color
attribute.description: Main signal colour (syncSuite hot pink).

attribute.name: grcolor
attribute.description: Gain reduction bars and curve.

attribute.name: overcolor
attribute.description: Overs and clips (acid yellow).

outlet.digest: Processed speaker feeds (same channels as the input)
